subject: Recap: latency vs cost trade-offs — pricing next steps
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@fintech.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow up + numbers from our call

Thanks again for the demo earlier — Tom and I appreciated the walkthrough. Two quick asks so we can model this on our side:

1) A back-of-envelope cost estimate for the two flows we covered (customer chat + batch summarization) expressed as $/1M tokens for each model tier. Target for procurement is to understand unit economics; Tom wants a believable target $/1M tokens to compare to our current vendor.

2) Confirmation on latency SLO trade-offs. We need to know approximate price delta if we target P95 <= 300ms (user chat) vs P95 <= 800ms (background summarization). We care about cost, so any guidance on batching settings or streaming impact would help.

Notes we shared on the call: expected 120M tokens/mo initially (chat heavy ~70%) with burst QPS up to ~90 requests/s at peak. Average prompt length ~120 tokens, response length ~220 tokens.

Can you send a short recap + next steps and a recommended pilot path (hosted vs dedicated) and whether a smaller model with quantization would give us the unit economics we need?

—Samira
Samira Khan
Head of ML Infrastructure, Paylytics

Attachment: paylytics-prod-patterns.csv (CSV)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@fintech.io>
Cc: Tom Underwood <tom@paylytics.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 18:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow up + numbers from our call

Samira — thanks for the clear notes, and great to meet you both. Recap and suggested next steps below. I attached a short pricing matrix (redwood-quick-pricing.pdf) and a token-econ template you can drop your numbers into.

Recap of your inputs (please correct if I mis-stated):
- Volumes: ~120M tokens/mo total; 70% chat, 30% batch summarization
- Peak: ~90 rps burst; baseline concurrency ~15–25
- Prompt/response tokens: ~120 in / ~220 out (avg per request ~340 tokens)
- Latency SLO: chat P95 target ~300ms; background can be 800ms P95

High-level unit economics (back-of-envelope) — hosted API (no commitment) vs dedicated pool (reserved GPUs):
- Hosted (continuous streaming, low-batch): ~ $900–$1,400 per 1M tokens for chat-tier models with streaming enabled (low latency path).
- Hosted (batch-optimized, higher latency allowance): ~ $420–$700 per 1M tokens for non-streaming batch inference with batching and KV caching.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity, moderate batching): per-1M-token cost can drop ~25–45% depending on utilization and quantization profile; e.g., $300–$525 per 1M tokens at target 70–80% utilization.

Drivers and trade-offs:
- Streaming vs batching: streaming keeps P95 latency low but prevents large batch windows; batching (100–200ms windows) can reduce unit cost significantly for background/async paths.
- Quantization + smaller model variants: moving from fp16 to 4-bit quantized model can cut GPU cost per token by ~30–50% but may require quality validation on your prompts — good candidate for background summarization.
- SLO-driven pricing: for strict 300ms P95 we recommend a hybrid routing policy — keep chat on a low-latency hosted tier or dedicated pool, route summarization to batch lanes with caching and lower-cost model variants. That gives you predictable tail latency while optimizing unit economics.

Proposed pilot options (two-week technical pilot):
- Option A — Hosted Pilot (fastest path): 2 weeks on hosted, enable streaming for chat, batch summarization on lower-cost tier. No commitment; we'll provide usage dashboard and token-econ estimate.
- Option B — Dedicated Trial: 1-month reserved trial with a small GPU pool (2–4 GPUs), run production traffic for chat lane. We can apply a pilot discount and build an SLA for the period.

Questions for you to finalize pricing:
- Can you confirm monthly committed budget range (ballpark)? e.g., <$10k, $10–40k, $40–150k, >$150k
- Do you require encryption keys (KMS/HSM) for the pilot?
- Any regulatory constraints that will force private deployment instead of hosted?

Next steps:
1) Samira/Tom to confirm budget band and KMS requirement.
2) I’ll send a tailored cost model showing $/1M tokens across tiers and a recommended routing policy (end of day Mon).
3) If you prefer Dedicated Trial, I’ll loop in Solutions and Ops for sizing and trial discounts.

Attachment: redwood-quick-pricing.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: token-econ-template.xlsx (XLSX)

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira@fintech.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Underwood <tom@paylytics.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 20:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow up + numbers from our call

Thanks Sean — that framing helps a lot. A few clarifications from our finance/ops side:
- Budget band: initially in the $40–150k/month window; we can consider >$150k with a strong committed discount and SLA.
- KMS: yes, we need customer-managed keys for the pilot (KMS).
- Model quality: we can run internal evals on the quantized variant; background summarization is flexible to lower quality.

On latency: for chat we need P95 <= 300ms at peak for key flows (customer support realtime). If Dedicated pool gets us reliably under that P95 at a 20–30% premium vs hosted low-latency tier, we may prefer Dedicated for that lane. For other batch jobs we accept P95 up to 800ms.

Please send the tailored cost model and a suggested pilot agreement (2-week hosted OR 1-month dedicated with trial discount). Tom, flag anything I missed.

—Samira
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@fintech.io>, Tom Underwood <tom@paylytics.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick follow up + numbers from our call — pricing next steps / approval request

Marissa — looping you in for discount / trial approval. Paylytics looks like a solid mid-market expansion opportunity; they’ve given committing band $40–150k/mo and require KMS for pilot. They want clarity on P95 300ms for chat.

Recommendation: offer a 20% pilot discount on Dedicated Trial (1 month, 3 GPU pool) and 30-day pilot SLA with a performance review. If finance okays margin, we can bake in an auto-rollover to 6-month reserved with stepped discounting tied to utilization.

Ask: can you approve pilot discount and confirm whether we can offer the KMS onboarding within the pilot? Also tagging Solutions to prod a sizing with 3 GPUs for chat lane and 1 GPU for batch tasks.

Thanks — I’ll prepare the pilot doc once we have approval.

—Sean
thread_notes: Customer asked for $/1M tokens and latency deltas. Internal ask: pilot discount approval and KMS support. Attachments provided: pricing PDF and token template.
